FN-U7Y1XG-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 304
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representatives Neil Rafferty
Government
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/21/2023
House Bill 304 as introduced would allow the Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Board to
license food or beverage trucks to sell alcoholic beverages for on-premises consumption in an
established entertainment district, regardless of the class of the municipality. This could increase
receipts to the State General Fund by $300 for each food or beverage truck license fee collected
due to the provisions of this bill, in addition to any other applicable application or renewal fee.
Page 1

House Bill 304
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representatives Neil Rafferty
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/31/2023
House Bill 304 as passed the House of Representatives would allow the Alcoholic Beverage
Control (ABC) Board to license food or beverage trucks to sell alcoholic beverages for
on-premises consumption in an established entertainment district, regardless of the class of the
municipality. This could increase receipts to the State General Fund by $300 for each food or
beverage truck license fee collected due to the provisions of this bill, in addition to any other
applicable application or renewal fee.
